# Battle Electric

> Battle Electric, LLC is a Florida certified and insured electrical contractor
> (License NO. EC13010206) based in Homestead, Florida, serving residential and
> commercial clients across Miami-Dade, Broward, and Monroe County (Upper Keys),
> plus Southwest Florida (Fort Myers and Lehigh Acres) and Greater Orlando
> (Winter Park, Altamonte Springs, and nearby areas). 35+ years of combined
> experience. Free estimates. 24/7 emergency service.

## Services

- [EV Charger Installation](https://www.battleelectricfl.com/services/ev-charging): Level 1, 2 & 3 charging stations, Tesla Wall Connector and universal chargers, for homes and businesses
- [Level 1 EV Charging](https://www.battleelectricfl.com/services/ev-charging/level-1): standard 120V outlet charging explained — speed, use cases, limitations
- [Level 2 EV Charging](https://www.battleelectricfl.com/services/ev-charging/level-2): 240V home and business charger installation, the most common residential upgrade
- [Level 3 EV Charging](https://www.battleelectricfl.com/services/ev-charging/level-3): DC fast charging for commercial sites and fleets
- [Electrical Panel Installation](https://www.battleelectricfl.com/services/electrical-panel): panel upgrades and replacements, safety inspections, insurance-required upgrades
- [Smart Electrical Panels](https://www.battleelectricfl.com/services/smart-panel): SPAN smart panel installation with energy monitoring and load management
- [All Services](https://www.battleelectricfl.com/services): plus general electrical work — rewiring, troubleshooting, lighting, smoke detectors, outlets, temporary power
